fullPassage: Creativity is the ability to generate novel and valuable ideas. It involves divergent thinking, imagination, and a willingness to experiment and take risks. While AI can be a powerful tool for creative efforts, it also carries the risk of limiting originality and innovation. AI algorithms are trained on existing datasets, often identifying patterns and trends in past creations. While this can be useful for generating new content in similar styles or formats, it can also lead to derivative works that lack genuine originality. If artists and designers rely too heavily on AI for inspiration and content generation, they may find themselves trapped in a cycle of imitation, unable to break free from the constraints of the AI's training data. Moreover, the ease with which AI can generate content can discourage the kind of struggle and experimentation that often leads to breakthroughs. The creative process is often messy and repetitive, involving numerous failures and setbacks. It is through these challenges that we refine our skills, develop our unique perspectives, and push the boundaries of what is possible. If AI provides instant solutions, it can enhance this essential process of learning through trial and error, ultimately inhibiting the development of true creative talent.

questions.passage: Creativity is the ability to generate (A)[novel / outdated] and (B)[valuable / worthless] ideas. It involves (C)[divergent / uniform] thinking, imagination, and a willingness to experiment and take risks. While AI can be a powerful tool for creative efforts, it also carries the risk of limiting originality and innovation. AI algorithms are trained on existing datasets, often identifying patterns and trends in past creations.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 창의성은 새롭고 가치 있는 아이디어를 만들어내는 능력이다. 그것은 확산적 사고, 상상력, 실험하고 위험을 감수하려는 의지를 포함한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ novel — valuable — divergent: 원문 그대로
❌ ① outdated(구식의)는 novel의 반의어
❌ ② worthless(가치 없는)는 valuable의 반의어
❌ ③ uniform(획일적인)은 divergent의 반의어
det.tip: novel=새로운/참신한, divergent thinking=확산적 사고 ↔ convergent thinking

questions.passage: While AI can be a powerful tool for creative efforts, it also carries the risk of limiting originality and innovation. AI algorithms are trained on (A)[existing / nonexistent] datasets, often identifying (B)[patterns / exceptions] and trends in past creations. While this can be useful for generating new content in similar styles or formats, it can also lead to derivative works that lack (C)[genuine / artificial] originality. If artists and designers rely too heavily on AI, they may find themselves trapped in a cycle of imitation. Moreover, the ease with which AI can generate content can discourage the kind of struggle that leads to breakthroughs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: AI 알고리즘은 기존의 데이터셋으로 훈련되어, 과거 창작물에서 패턴과 트렌드를 식별한다. 이것은 진정한 독창성이 부족한 파생 작품으로 이어질 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② existing — patterns — genuine: 원문 일치
❌ ① nonexistent(존재하지 않는)는 existing의 반의어
❌ ③ exceptions(예외)는 patterns(패턴)과 반대 개념
❌ ④ artificial(인위적인)은 genuine(진정한)의 반의어
det.tip: existing datasets=기존 데이터셋, genuine originality=진정한 독창성

questions.passage: While this can be useful for generating new content in similar styles or formats, it can also lead to derivative works that lack genuine originality. If artists and designers rely too heavily on AI for inspiration and content generation, they may find themselves (A)[trapped / liberated] in a cycle of imitation, unable to break free from the constraints of the AI's training data. Moreover, the ease with which AI can generate content can (B)[discourage / encourage] the kind of struggle and experimentation that often leads to breakthroughs. The creative process is often messy and repetitive, involving numerous failures and setbacks. It is through these challenges that we refine our skills, develop our unique perspectives, and push the (C)[boundaries / centers] of what is possible.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: AI에 지나치게 의존하면 모방의 순환에 갇힐 수 있다. AI의 편리함이 고군분투와 실험을 억제할 수 있다. 이런 도전을 통해 가능한 것의 경계를 넓힌다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① trapped — discourage — boundaries: 원문 그대로
❌ ② liberated(해방된)는 trapped의 반의어, 모방의 순환에 '해방'은 모순
❌ ③ encourage(장려)는 discourage의 반의어, AI의 부정적 영향 맥락과 모순
❌ ④ centers(중심)는 push the boundaries 관용표현에 어울리지 않음
det.tip: trapped in a cycle=순환에 갇히다, push the boundaries=한계를 넓히다

While AI can be a ①<u>powerful</u> tool for creative efforts, it also carries the risk of ②<u>limiting</u> originality and ③<u>innovation</u>. Moreover, the ease with which AI can generate content can ④<u>encourage</u> the kind of struggle and experimentation that often leads to breakthroughs.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①강력한 ②제한하는 ③혁신 ④장려하다(→discourage 억제하다)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ encourage(장려하다)는 discourage(억제하다)로 바뀌어야 함. AI가 쉽게 콘텐츠를 만들면 고군분투를 '장려'하는 것이 아니라 '억제'하므로 문맥에 부적절
❌ ①②③ 원문 일치
det.tip: encourage(장려) ↔ discourage(억제). 맥락: AI의 편리함 → 노력 억제

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ①새로운 ②가치 있는 ③일반적인(→divergent 확산적인) ④강력한
det.analysis:
✅ ③ common(일반적인)은 divergent(확산적인)로 바뀌어야 함. 창의성에는 '일반적' 사고가 아닌 '확산적' 사고가 필요
❌ ①②④ 원문 일치
det.tip: divergent(확산적인) ↔ common(일반적인)/convergent(수렴적인)

det.korean: ①훈련된 ②무시하는(→identifying 식별하는) ③파생적인 ④갇힌

det.tip: identify(식별하다) ↔ ignore(무시하다). AI는 데이터에서 패턴을 '식별'

questions.passage: Creativity is the ability to generate novel and valuable ideas. It involves divergent thinking, imagination, and a willingness to experiment and take risks. While AI can be a powerful tool for creative efforts, it also carries the risk of limiting originality and innovation. AI algorithms are trained on existing datasets, often identifying patterns and trends in past creations. While this can be useful for generating new content in similar styles or formats, it can also lead to derivative works that lack genuine originality. If artists and designers rely too heavily on AI for inspiration and content generation, they may find themselves trapped in a cycle of imitation, unable to break free from the constraints of the AI's training data. Moreover, the ease with which AI can generate content can discourage the kind of struggle and experimentation that often leads to breakthroughs. The creative process is often messy and repetitive, involving numerous failures and setbacks. It is through these challenges that we refine our skills, develop our unique perspectives, and ____. If AI provides instant solutions, it can enhance this essential process of learning through trial and error, ultimately inhibiting the development of true creative talent.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이러한 도전을 통해 우리는 기술을 연마하고, 독특한 관점을 발전시키고, ________한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② push the boundaries of what is possible: 원문 그대로. 세 가지 병렬 구조의 마지막 요소
❌ ① copy existing patterns — 기존 패턴 복사는 AI의 한계이지 창의적 성장이 아님
❌ ③ follow established norms — 기존 규범 따르기는 독창성과 반대
❌ ④ limit our creative potential — 잠재력 제한은 AI의 부정적 결과이지 도전의 결과가 아님
det.tip: push the boundaries = 한계를 넓히다. refine, develop, push 세 동사 병렬

ch: push the boundaries of what is possible
